Who books with us

Sports-card dealers, Pokémon and TCG shops, singles grinders, sealed accounts, memorabilia tables, and collectors who want one serious weekend on a busy floor.

What you get

  • 8-foot table space (confirm size per event on Treasure)
  • A floor built for sports + TCG, not one or the other
  • Heavy weekend foot traffic at Foxwoods; tight, deal-heavy rooms at local shows
  • Easy Treasure checkout and table management
  • A promoter that also runs a 7-day shop — we live in the hobby all week, not just on show day

Rainmaker Expo Center inside Foxwoods Casino. 300+ tables. Two days. Free Saturday trade night. This is the show dealers plan travel around.

Local CT shows

Friday-night and Sunday rooms (New Britain VFW, Truck Bar, and rotating venues). Smaller table counts, lower price point, strong local repeat traffic. Good for testing product or filling a weekend between Foxwoods dates.

How to book

  • Pick the show on Treasure.
  • Choose table type (standard, wall, extras if offered).
  • Check out.
  • Watch @hardhittincardshows for load-in, map, and day-of notes.

Questions before you pay: DM @hardhittincardshows or call/text the shop at 860-316-1075.

Vendor FAQ

Before You Book

How do I get a table at a Hard Hittin' show?

Reserve your table through Treasure from the show page. Prime Foxwoods floor space sells first. Questions before you book: DM @hardhittincardshows or call the shop at 860-316-1075.

Can I split a table?

Ask before you book. Policy can vary by show and leftover inventory.

When do tables sell out?

Foxwoods prime and wall spots go first. Local shows can fill in the last two weeks. Book when the date drops.

Do you take walk-up vendors?

Don’t count on it. If a cancellation opens a spot we post it on Instagram.

Load-in and power?

Posted on each Treasure event and in the vendor email. Read both before you drive.

Where is the Foxwoods card show?

Rainmaker Expo Center at Foxwoods Resort Casino, 350 Trolley Line Blvd, Mashantucket, CT 06338. Free parking on site.

Do Hard Hittin' shows include sports cards and TCG?

Yes. Floors are built for sports cards plus Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, memorabilia, and sealed product.

Can I submit cards to PSA at a Hard Hittin' show?

Yes. Hard Hittin' Cards accepts PSA submissions at the Southington shop and at the shop booth on the show floor.
